value.rationale: The Poisson p=4 endpoint is a current motivated open problem. A natural stronger L4-to-L4 spectral-gap strategy is valid on all centered degree-two harmonics but fails for every radius as soon as the first cubic resonance enters. The exact and uniquely attained sharp 1.02744398... limiting amplification quantifies this barrier, rather than just showing a cheap negative case. Its three-character space is the first resonant centered frequency block; the full cutoff and complete optimizer classification are natural structural data.
